opening.argument: The strongest evidence is the creator’s own list of passive-income programs, which advertises fixed or capped returns and pairs each offer with an invitation to participate. Ether Chain promises “Earn 1% daily on your ethereum, 30% monthly upto 310% Join here:,” while FX Success offers “Earn 7% pure profits on your investments in bitcoin Join here:.” A third program promises returns of up to 200% and directs viewers to register an account. The spoken discussion is primarily educational about Ethereum gas fees, but it also names several of the same programs, including EtherChain. These repeated promotions and joining or registration prompts make investment participation a material part of the video, despite the educational framing of its spoken content.
